descriptionChirho: To cause to multiply or increase in number, used of God multiplying seed (2 Cor 9:10) or promising to multiply Abraham's descendants (Heb 6:14), with an active agent doing the multiplying.

To be multiplied, grow in number, or increase, used of the church multiplying (Acts 6:7, 9:31, 12:24), the people increasing in Egypt (Acts 7:17), lawlessness increasing (Matt 24:12), and in epistolary greetings 'may grace and peace be multiplied to you' (1 Pet 1:2, 2 Pet 1:2, Jude 1:2).
